async def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: python3 omnios_cli.py <command> [args_json]")
        print("Available commands: list_tools, execute <tool_name> <args_json>")
        sys.exit(1)
        
    command = sys.argv[1]
    
    async with OmniOSAgentHarness(agent_id="Antigravity_CLI") as harness:
        if command == "list_tools":
            schemas = harness.get_llm_tool_schemas()
            print(json.dumps(schemas, indent=2))
            
        elif command == "execute":
            if len(sys.argv) < 4:
                print("Usage: python3 omnios_cli.py execute <tool_name> <args_json>")
                sys.exit(1)
            tool_name = sys.argv[2]
            try:
                args = json.loads(sys.argv[3])
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Error parsing args_json: {e}")
                sys.exit(1)
                
            res = await harness.execute_in_swarm(tool_name, args, timeout=10.0)
            print(json.dumps(res, indent=2))
        else:
            print(f"Unknown command: {command}")
            sys.exit(1)
